messages:
sam: quick heads-up — we flipped on strict response_schema enforcement for /v2/generate in prod canary (us-west-2) and are seeing a handful of 400s from older clients.

maria: which field is failing? any logs?

sam: here's a cut of the failing response we logged:

sam: ```json
{"request_id":"r-12","response":{"choices":[{"text":"ok"}],"metadata":null}}
```

sam: validator rejects because schema expects an object for `metadata` (no nullable). older clients are sending "metadata": null instead of omitting the key.

kai: @sam thanks. schema in api repo says `metadata` is optional but typed as object (no "nullable"), so strict mode treats null as invalid.

maria: historically our parsers accepted both missing and null. strict enforcement tightened that.

sam: options on the table: revert enforcement; relax validator to accept null; update SDKs/clients to stop serializing null.

jen: leaning toward accepting null for now to avoid customer impact, but we should ship SDK fix asap so clients omit the field.

maria: can we gate the relaxed behavior behind a feature flag so we get telemetry on how many requests/clients rely on null?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for feature flag `response_tolerance.null_object` at 16:30 UTC.

sam: plan: enable tolerant parsing in prod canary, emit telemetry (client_id + null_vs_missing counts), and open SDK PR to stop serializing nulls. if telemetry shows low usage we will remove tolerant mode and keep strict.

kai: i'll open SDK PR today to change default serializer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/431 — will add a compatibility note.

maria: i'll add a note in api-schema repo and CHANGELOG about temporary acceptance of null for legacy clients. will tag as deprecated in the spec.

sam: created a ticket to trigger revert if error rate doesn't improve: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-789 (assign rollback owners + thresholds).

jen: :thumbsup: assign me for the rollback playbook. i'll also watch canary telemetry.

sam: thanks, will post quick canary status updates in this thread. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot changed the channel topic to "deploy: canary response_tolerance.null_object enabled"
